title: Bug: syslog: test_basic_syslog_config failure due to mismatch in IPv6 case format
author: rminnikanti
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

Mgmt IPv6 gateway address configured in upper case in sonic-mgmt causes syslog testcase failure.

```
cat ansible/lab
  hosts:
    str-marvell-01:
      ansible_host: 10.28.60.9
      ansible_hostv6 : FC00:2::52
```

mgmt interface IP configuration on DUT:
```
    "MGMT_INTERFACE": {
        "eth0|10.28.60.9/24": {
            "forced_mgmt_routes": [
                "172.17.0.1/24"
            ],
            "gwaddr": "10.28.60.1"
        },
        "eth0|FC00:2::52/64": {
            "gwaddr": "fc00:2::1"
        }
    }
```

### Steps to Reproduce

Run syslog/test_syslog_source_ip.py tests
```
syslog/test_syslog_source_ip.py::TestSSIP::test_basic_syslog_config[str-marvell-01-None-vrf_set_source_set_None] 
```


### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Actual behavior is test case failure:
```
syslog/test_syslog_source_ip.py::TestSSIP::test_basic_syslog_config[str-marvell-01-None-vrf_set_source_set_None] FAILED                                                             [100%]
```
Expected behavior is test case pass.

### Relevant log output

```shell
E               Failed: Excepted syslog config: server_ip fc00:2::1, source_ip FC00:2::52, vrf mgmt, port 800 doesn't exist

is_set_source = True
is_set_vrf = True
k          = 'ipv6'
port       = 800

v          = {'source_ip': 'FC00:2::52/64', 'syslog_server_ip': 'fc00:2::1', 'syslog_server_mac': '90:90:90:90:90:32'}
vrf        = 'mgmt'
vrf_list   = ['default', 'Vrf-data', 'mgmt']

syslog/test_syslog_source_ip.py:375: Failed
```

linkedPullRequests.body:
### Description of PR
Ignore case when validating IPv6 address in syslog CLI output
`show syslog` CLI output shows IPv6 address in lower case.
But PTF ansible's can have IPv6 configuration in any case. This leads to test failure 

Sample Sonic PTF ansible IPv6 config:
```
ansible_hostv6 : FC00:2::32
```
Sonic DUT CLI output:
```
root@str-marvell-01:/home/admin# show syslog
SERVER IP      SOURCE IP      PORT    VRF
-------------  -------------  ------  --------
10.28.60.1     10.28.60.9     800     mgmt
100.100.100.1  100.100.100.2  800     default
200.200.200.1  200.200.200.2  800     Vrf-data
2221::1111     2221::1112     800     Vrf-data
2222::1111     2222::1112     800     default
fc00:2::1      fc00:2::32     800     mgmt      <===
```

Summary:
Fixes #18438

### Approach
Change CLI validation code in test_syslog_source_ip.py to perform IPv6 validation in lower case.
